PHASE_F_G_ORPHAN_PROCESS_REAL_BUG_FOUND_.ROOT_CAUSE: execFileSync's own `timeout`/`killSignal` mechanism SIGKILLs only the ONE tracked child pid (`podman build` itself); it has no way to also reach that child's own descendants. Under `--isolation=chroot`, a build's RUN-step process (e.g. a nested `mvn`) shares this container's OWN pid namespace rather than getting one of its own, so a SIGKILLed `podman build` never gets the chance to run its own `--force-rm` teardown, orphaning that RUN-step process -- reparented to this image's PID 1 (`node`), which (unlike a real init) never reaps a process it did not itself spawn

Deliberately NOT also filtered to 'ppid==1 only': a real reproduction test showed some environments interpose a process-subreaper above literal PID 1, which would otherwise cause exactly the real orphans this sweep exists to catch to be silently skipped.
